about: Apply to the Dubai medical or dental residency training programme. For healthcare professionals only.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for healthcare professionals (doctors, dentists, nurses and similar), not for patients or the general public
For doctors who have completed internship
Available only during the registration period
documents: Recent photo, passport, Emirates ID if applicable
CV, ECE report for graduates from outside the UAE, PSV report
National Service completion or exemption for UAE males
fees: AED 620 in total, made up of registration and review, Knowledge and Innovation fees
timing: 2 months after the registration period closes
